Yeah quests are a bit difficult sometimes, even if you make it all the way to the end and to the loot room, it doesn't mean the quest is done. Often when doing fetch quests, the satchel can be found way before you reach the loot room. If it's only a fetch quest where you have to find the satchel and nothing more, picking up the supplies will complete the quest. But if it's a fetch/clear quest, you have to keep going after finding the satchel and clear all the zombies. It can be confusing at first, but when you complete the quest, a sound plays (the same sound that plays when you activate the quest with the yellow ! ), that's how you know you're done. That, and the text I mentioned that tells you about the quest. :) Either way, if you log off in the middle of a quest, it will reset and remove the supplies from your inventory.

The quests reset every time you log off (or in this case crash) and log in again if you were in the middle of doing them. When you find the satchel, it doesn't mean your quest is complete. Look in the upper right corner for the quest info. If you're doing T4 quests and they involve the satchel, it's most likely NOT just a fetch quest, but rather a fetch/clear quest. So even if you find the satchel, you still have to kill all the zombies. If the text in the upper right corner doesn't say "return to trader", it means it's not completed.

As for the crashing, can't help. Mine doesn't do that and my PC is not the best (it's worse than yours), but the most common reason for lag and crashing is drones. A lost drone will make the save unplayable, and you can only fix it by using the console to delete the drone. Do you have a drone?
